Review the current worktree diff against the attached issue JSON, acceptance criteria, declared touch-set, repository rules, and tests. Fix every concrete defect you find without expanding scope. Run focused checks for any fix — never repo-wide `make check` or the full test suite: the controller runs it afterwards in its own serialized phase, and a concurrent full run contends with it for the check lock and test containers. The executor's git isolation env (`GIT_CONFIG_*`/`GH_*`) is intentional; do not unset or work around it.

Reject tests that are implementation-coupled (mock internal collaborators, test private methods), tautological (expected value derived the same way as the code), or horizontally sliced (all tests written before all implementation). Verify test-first was followed at the ticket's declared seams unless the change is purely mechanical.

Comment hygiene is a mandatory review item, not a suggestion. Repository rule (AGENTS.md, the sole standard): a comment is allowed only when it states an external system's implicit contract or quirk, a business invariant or negative-space constraint the code cannot express, or the direct reason a workaround exists. A business invariant (a domain rule the code alone cannot prove, e.g. "每用户最多 10 把 active key") is not design intent — it is whitelisted. Delete comments that cite their provenance ("根据 docs/…", "参考 ADR …", "按照 issue #… 的要求"), narrate change history ("以前是…现在改为…", "原来这里用的是…"), restate what the code already says, narrate design intent or architecture (module/file header doc blocks explaining what the module is for, how pieces fit together, which layer calls it; endpoint doc comments summarizing behavior the signature and schema already show), or explain/justify already-written code ("why this way", "why an alternative is impossible", "the benefit of writing it this way" — re-explaining written code is noise and dilutes model attention). This applies both to comments added in the diff and to pre-existing violations in the files the diff touches; do not edit files outside the diff. Never delete functional directive comments consumed by tools (`eslint-disable`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, `cspell:`, etc.) or comments that encode a real constraint as defined above. When unsure whether a comment states an external (third-party/database/tooling) contract, keep it; when unsure whether it states a genuine invariant, delete it (AGENTS.md 审计规则：答不上来即删); design intent is never protected.

Do not call GitHub, commit, push, create or edit issues, or open/merge a PR. Exit non-zero when the work cannot be made correct within scope.
